campaign.title: Persistent critical balanced j=1 two-defect commutator identity-or-no-go gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: No new survey is scheduled. If a named theorem is invoked, audit every hypothesis and restored power.

frozen_target.question: Does the complete persistent critical j=1 balanced double-far zero-subtracted scalar admit an exact two-direction defect commutator identity that preserves every literal weight and saves one factor L before positive norms, or what is the first exact identity, axial, boundary, restoration, capacity, or ruling no-go?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For a_B^<(h,k)=chi_4(h) eta((h,k)/(sqrt L/2)) A_B(h,k), Delta=h'k'-hk, rho=hk'-h'k, and df={|Delta|>L,|rho|>L}, prove |R_B^osc|<<_epsilon L^3X^epsilon, where R_B^osc=sum_df a_B^<(h,k)conj(a_B^<(h',k'))[e(sqrt X(sqrt(hk)-sqrt(h'k')))-1]. With h'=h+p and k'=k+q, Delta+rho=q(2h+p) and Delta-rho=p(2k+q). These are coordinates, not a proved commutator.
quantities: The target is scoped only to persistent critical j=1 blocks with L asymp X^(1/6).
Positive capacity is L^4X^epsilon; exactly one factor L must be saved before a positive norm.
On character support p=2s and chi_4(h)chi_4(h+p)=(-1)^s, constant on fixed-p fibres.
The p=0 and q=0 axial sectors may satisfy both far gates and cannot be divided away.
The phase-free term, true diagonal, and two width-L corridors are target-safe, but fixed-Q rulings remain.
No critical-child result implies hard TOP, UNBAL, M1, GAR, endpoint assembly, a bridge, or an exponent theorem.

completion_criteria: Give an exact finite coordinate domain, inverse, and multiplicity ledger for (h,k,h',k') and (h,k,p,q).
State and prove two discrete difference operators and the exact coefficientwise commutator identity, or isolate its first exact failure.
Retain fixed-p character constancy and prove target-safe treatment of p=0 and q=0 axial sectors.
Expand every sharp-gate and support-boundary correction and retain fixed-Q rulings.
Restore both gcd weights, both slanted symbols, characters, lifts, floors, stars, aliases, crossings, endpoints, and the real centre.
Save one factor L before positive norms and price the complement by L^3X^epsilon, or prove the first unavoidable capacity obstruction.
Pass constant-character, erased-structure, phase-adapted-coefficient, statement-only, power, and owner-scope controls.
Close under exactly one campaign terminal label.
